headline: bil022 jumps from 3,486th to 55th on ARC-3

sections.text: bil022 gained 35.05 to reach 35.26, leaping from 3,486th to 55th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The move puts bil022 among the top 100 in a single reported rise; the public standings remain provisional.
